metadata.title: iOS Shortcut — Remove Gemini Watermark in One Tap
metadata.description: Download the iOS shortcut to instantly remove Gemini AI watermarks from images via the share menu in Photos, X, and other apps.

title: iOS Shortcut
description: Install this shortcut to remove Gemini watermarks directly from the share menu in Photos, X, or any app. No browser needed — process images anytime, anywhere.
install_description: Tap the button below to install directly on your iPhone, or download the file and import it manually.
api_key_description: Sign in, purchase credits, and generate an API Key for unlimited use.
personal_url_description: Copy the URL below and paste it into the shortcut's URL field. Your API Key is already embedded — no extra setup needed!
personal_url_hint: Open the shortcut in Shortcuts app → find the URL field → paste this URL
step3_instruction1: Open a Gemini-generated image — it can be from your Photos, X (Twitter), or any other app.
step3_instruction2: Tap the Share button, then select the shortcut "RemoveGeminiWatermark.org" from the share menu.
step3_instruction3: Tap to run the shortcut. The image will be uploaded and processed automatically.
step3_instruction4: The processed image without the watermark will be saved to your Photos automatically!

step1.title: Select Image
step1.description: Open a Gemini-generated image in Photos, X, or any app.

step3.title: Auto Process
step3.description: Image is uploaded, watermark removed in 2-3 seconds. Supports PNG, JPEG, WebP.

step4.title: Save Result
step4.description: Clean image saved to Photos as PNG. Original is never modified.

notes.note2: Only supports original Gemini-generated images. Non-Gemini images will not have watermarks detected.
notes.note3: Works entirely via the share menu — no need to open a browser or visit a website.

tips.tip1: Generate your API Key from Settings > API Keys to get your personal URL, then paste it into the shortcut for unlimited use.
tips.tip2: Batch processing is supported: select multiple images in Photos and share them all at once.
